name: io.github.seayniclabs/privacyops
description: Track credit-bureau disputes and draft dispute letters from fixed templates, locally.

environmentVariables.name: PRIVACYOPS_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for your dispute records and letters. Default: ~/.local/share/privacyops

environmentVariables.name: PRIVACYOPS_DISPUTES_ALLOW_DELETE
environmentVariables.description: true lets the assistant delete a dispute record without asking you. Default false.
